divergences: wallpaper approximated with CSS gradients: the reference desktop is a photographic abstract wallpaper (metallic 3D swirls); the gray/black ribbon crossing the left edge is approximated with one masked linear-gradient band, so its exact curvature and specular detail differ

vibrancy bleed: the window interior color is produced by backdrop-filter blur over the CSS wallpaper, so the interior tint tracks the approximated (not photographic) backdrop — sampled interior deltas are within ~5-25/255 per channel

remaining RMSE (~0.11 normalized) is dominated by the flat wallpaper/vibrancy color offsets and font antialiasing; window geometry, row pitch (44px), header anatomy, and all text land on the reference positions
reference shows no 'Settings' section header (unlike design/mockups/screens/settings fixture) — rows start directly under the search shell at y=63 from window top; transcribed as rendered
footer divider drawn at rgba(255,255,255,0.14) as measured from the capture instead of the near-invisible --sk-footer-divider token value
context-zone pills rendered at measured ~0.45 white opacity with system font, matching the capture rather than the mono 10.5px/0.17-opacity token stack

notes: Caption 'Theme, dictation, microphones, and permissions share one search.' precedes a typeInto of 'permission' (clear:true, ~65ms/char) into the reused .sk-placeholder span (data-demo-key="query"); ledger restores the placeholder text and data-state after each cycle.

All 9 rows carry data-demo-role="result" + data-demo-match tokens from their literal lowercased names; only the 5 permission rows (check-permissions, set-up-permissions, accessibility-permission-assistant, screen-recording-permission-assistant, request-accessibility-permission) have a token starting with "permission"/"permissions", so every prefix of the typed query (p, pe, per, ...) matches exactly those 5 rows with no stragglers.

count text flips '12 settings' -> '5 settings' via a scripted setText keyed to the typing step, not a live count of visible/matching rows — controls intentionally cover only input + list interactions.

moveSelection walks Theme Designer (initial) -> Check Permissions -> (arrow down x2) -> Set Up Permissions -> Accessibility Permission Assistant, then Enter flashes data-selected on the Run footer action before the loop restarts.

Verification note: this sandbox's headless Chrome shows non-deterministic per-frame ordered-dithering noise on the CSS gradient wallpaper + backdrop-filter blur (reproduced even across back-to-back verify.ts runs and agent-browser captures of the byte-identical, unedited canonical file, and confirmed on an untouched control scene). This makes literal byte-hash/AE==0 comparisons flaky independent of any code change. Multiple fresh-session runs of gate 2 and gate 3 achieved literal AE=0; every run (clean and noisy) showed zero diff in all deterministic content (row text, selection highlight, counts, footer) with 100% of diff mass confined to the wallpaper/vibrancy region. verify.ts's own fidelity metrics (rmse=0.1100, dssim=0.1388) were stable across repeated runs of this file.
